app_manage() { sudo -n bash -c '
 set -a
 . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
 set +a
 export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production
 cd /srv/lowcost-europa
 runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- .venv/bin/python manage.py "$@"
 ' bash "$@"; }
app_manage shell -c '
from datetime import timedelta
from django.db.models import OuterRef,Subquery
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferObservation,OfferFamilyPlacement,OfferCandidate,ProductFamily
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
now=timezone.now()
families=ProductFamily.objects.exclude(status="RETIRED")
base=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now),is_active=True,owner_hidden=False,family_placements__product_family__in=families).distinct()
latest=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk")).order_by("-observed_at","-pk")
q=base.annotate(latest_availability=Subquery(latest.values("availability")[:1]),latest_at=Subquery(latest.values("observed_at")[:1]),latest_price=Subquery(latest.values("price")[:1]),latest_delivery=Subquery(latest.values("delivery_days")[:1]),latest_destination=Subquery(latest.values("destination_country")[:1]))
print("ELIGIBLE="+str(q.count()))
for k in ["AVAILABLE","UNKNOWN","UNAVAILABLE",None]:
 print("LATEST_AVAILABILITY_"+str(k)+"="+str(q.filter(latest_availability=k).count()))
print("OBSERVATIONS_MISSING="+str(q.filter(latest_at__isnull=True).count()))
print("OBSERVATIONS_STALE_24H="+str(q.filter(latest_at__lt=now-timedelta(hours=24)).count()))
print("OBSERVATIONS_STALE_7D="+str(q.filter(latest_at__lt=now-timedelta(days=7)).count()))
print("LATEST_PRICE_MISSING="+str(q.filter(latest_price__isnull=True).count()))
print("LATEST_DELIVERY_GT_5="+str(q.filter(latest_delivery__gt=5).count()))
print("LATEST_DELIVERY_UNKNOWN="+str(q.filter(latest_delivery__isnull=True).count()))
print("LATEST_DEST_OTHER_THAN_PT="+str(q.exclude(latest_destination="PT").count()))
print("ELIGIBLE_AFFILIATE_LINK_EMPTY="+str(q.filter(affiliate_url="").count()))
print("ELIGIBLE_IMAGE_MISSING="+str(q.filter(image_url="").count()))
print("ELIGIBLE_PROTOCOL_NULL="+str(q.filter(protocol_verified_at__isnull=True).count()))
for family in families.order_by("display_order"):
 n=OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(product_family=family,offer__in=base).count()
 print("FAMILY_PUBLIC="+str(family.slug)+";OFFERS="+str(n))
print("PENDING_CANDIDATES="+str(OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING").count()))
print("CANDIDATE_PENDING_IMAGE_MISSING="+str(OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING",image_url="").count()))
print("CATALOG_DEEP_READ=PASS")
'
echo CATALOG_DEEP_END=PASS

for unit in lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service lowcost-europa-affiliate-report.service; do
 echo "UNIT=$unit"
 systemctl show "$unit" --property=Result,ExecMainStatus,ActiveState,InactiveExitTimestamp,ExecMainExitTimestamp,ExecMainStartTimestamp --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Result|ExecMainStatus|ActiveState|InactiveExitTimestamp|ExecMainExitTimestamp|ExecMainStartTimestamp)=' || true
done
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager | grep -E 'lowcost-europa|restic' | cut -c 1-180 || true
for p in /srv/lowcost-europa /var/log /var/lib; do test -d "$p" && echo "PATH_EXISTS=$p"; done
echo OPS_DEEP_END=PASS

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo SECURITY_HTTP_START=1
base=https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
headers="$(curl -fsS -I --max-time 20 "$base/" | tr -d '\r')"
for h in strict-transport-security x-frame-options x-content-type-options referrer-policy content-security-policy x-robots-tag; do
 v="$(printf '%s\n' "$headers" | grep -i "^$h:" | head -1 || true)"
 if test -n "$v"; then echo "HEADER_$h=PRESENT"; else echo "HEADER_$h=ABSENT"; fi
done
for p in /painel/ /admin/; do
 code="$(curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$base$p")"
 echo "PRIVATE_PATH=$p;HTTP=$code"
done
echo SECURITY_HTTP_END=PASS
